events.title: Alert staff of
events.description: Moves into a status alert the staff when that status's Staff alert is on (Order statuses and moves).

staffPermission.title: Also alert Accounts staff who can
staffPermission.description: Also alert Accounts staff whose role has this permission (orders.read for orders, returns.manage for claims), or all_staff for everyone who works with what the alert is about. Needs the Accounts connection. Empty: only the people listed above.

adminUrl.title: Order page address in your admin
adminUrl.description: The page of your admin where staff open an order, for example https://admin.example.com/orders/{id}. Alerts link to it; {number} and {id} fill in the order.

includePhone.title: Alerts carry the shopper's phone
includePhone.description: Adds the value {phone} (the phone on the order) to every staff alert.
